We
began
our
investigation
of
the
changes
associated
with
the
development
of

swimming
activity
in
larval
bonito
by
examining
swimming
behavior ,
labeling

motoneurons
using
the
fluorescent
dye
Dil ,
and
using
EMG
analysis
to
study
muscle

activity .
We
show
that
development
of
bonito
swimming
is
associated
with
rapid

development
of
the
motoneuron
system
and
muscle
activity
which
correlates
to
the

swimming
mode
exhibited .
